## Checklist

- [ ] `uv run ruff check python/`, `uv run mypy python/`, and `uv run pytest` pass.
- [ ] The change contains no secrets, `.env` contents, or account details.
- [ ] The change contains no Kalshi market data. Test fixtures use made-up values.
- [ ] No change makes the bot place orders by default.
- [ ] Unrelated code is not reformatted.
